claims.claim: Xbox One console with one controller (one pad) for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black game console and a controller, but brand/model text is not readable; no clear Xbox One branding or model identifier is shown.
No photos show game discs/cases or a list of included games.
No photo shows the power adaptor/cable or any damage; the issue is only from the seller’s words.

risks.risk: Console brand/model may not be Xbox One (could be another console that looks similar).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/model number (rear/bottom sticker) and the front branding/logo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/unknown game console with controller, worst-case compatibility and value.

risks.risk: Power/adaptor problem may mean the console cannot power on or may have unstable power.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the console powering on from the provided adaptor (indicator lights + boot screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully working / power issue until demonstrated.

risks.risk: Included games may be missing, not the claimed titles, or not playable.
risks.proof: Photos of all 6 game discs/cases (front/back) and a video showing one game launching from disc.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controller only (no games assumed).

risks.risk: Controller may have drift, unresponsive buttons, or may not be the only controller.
risks.proof: A video showing controller input test (on-screen movement) and button presses responding correctly.
risks.if_unproven: Price with controller assumed possibly faulty (worst-case).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (HDMI/AV, power cable, controller charging cable/headset) could reduce usability.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of every included accessory with cables clearly visible (power, HDMI, controller charging, headset if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing unknown accessories; assume only what is shown/confirmed.

risks.risk: Storage/drive condition unknown (HDD/SSD size, disc drive health, ports/network).
risks.proof: A booted photo/video showing storage info and a quick test of disc drive/ports (HDMI output + network connection screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: disc/ports/storage unknown and may require repair.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console rear/bottom label showing brand, exact model, and serial number.
Video showing the console powering on using the provided adaptor (indicator lights + boot screen).
Photos of all included games (all 6 discs/cases) and confirm the exact titles (including FC).
Video showing one game launching and running from disc.
Video/input test for the controller (movement + button responsiveness) to check drift.
Photo of all accessories included laid out (power cable/adaptor, HDMI/AV, controller charging cable, headset if any).
response.reason: The witness confirms a console and controller exist, but the key pricing drivers (exact Xbox One model, adaptor/power issue severity, and included games) are not verifiable from the photos. Proof is needed to avoid overpaying for a potentially non-working or different console.
